nodes.title: A compact Euclidean set has a point not strictly between two others
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (L : Set LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space), L.Nonempty → IsCompact L → ∃ z ∈ L, ¬ ∃ x ∈ L, ∃ y ∈ L, x ≠ y ∧ ∃ a ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, z = (1 - a) • x + a • y

nodes.title: Smooth transitivity of frozen knot paths
nodes.lean_statement: let KnotPath : (ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) → (ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) → Prop := fun f g => ∃ A : ℝ → ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space, ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => A p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, A t 0 = f t) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, A t 1 = g t) ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.IsSmoothKnot (fun t : ℝ => A t s); ∀ {f g h : ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space}, KnotPath f g → KnotPath g h → KnotPath f h

nodes.title: Transfer of frozen nontriviality along a knot path
nodes.lean_statement: let KnotPath : (ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) → (ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) → Prop := fun f g => ∃ A : ℝ → ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space, ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => A p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, A t 0 = f t) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, A t 1 = g t) ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.IsSmoothKnot (fun t : ℝ => A t s); ∀ {f g : ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space}, KnotPath f g → (¬ LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.IsUnknotted f) → ¬ LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.IsUnknotted g

nodes.title: Positive period and unique fundamental representative
nodes.lean_statement: 0 < LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period ∧ ∀ x : AddCircle LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period, ∃! t : ℝ, t ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period ∧ (t : AddCircle LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period) = x

nodes.title: Centered squared-norm variance identity
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (b x y : LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) (a : ℝ), ‖(1 - a) • x + a • y - b‖ ^ 2 = (1 - a) * ‖x - b‖ ^ 2 + a * ‖y - b‖ ^ 2 - a * (1 - a) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2

nodes.title: A distance bound excludes strict convex combinations
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (L : Set LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) (b z : LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space), (∀ w ∈ L, ‖w - b‖ ≤ ‖z - b‖) → ¬ ∃ x ∈ L, ∃ y ∈ L, x ≠ y ∧ ∃ a ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, z = (1 - a) • x + a • y

nodes.title: Uniform C¹ endpoint control by power reparametrizations
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space), ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period, ‖F t (s ^ n) - F t 0‖ < ε ∧ ‖deriv (fun u : ℝ => F u (s ^ n)) t - deriv (fun u : ℝ => F u 0) t‖ < ε) ∧ (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period, ‖F t (1 - (1 - s) ^ n) - F t 1‖ < ε ∧ ‖deriv (fun u : ℝ => F u (1 - (1 - s) ^ n)) t - deriv (fun u : ℝ => F u 1) t‖ < ε)

nodes.title: Uniform C¹ stability of an analytic family of frozen knots
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space), ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) → (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.IsSmoothKnot (fun t : ℝ => F t s)) → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ r : ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space, ContDiff ℝ ⊤ r → Function.Periodic r LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period, ‖r t - F t s‖ < ε) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period, ‖deriv r t - deriv (fun u : ℝ => F u s) t‖ < ε) → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.IsSmoothKnot r

nodes.title: Uniform power endpoint control for a continuous family
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (G : ℝ → ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space), Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G p.1 p.2) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period, ‖G t (s ^ n) - G t 0‖ < ε) ∧ (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period, ‖G t (1 - (1 - s) ^ n) - G t 1‖ < ε)

nodes.title: Joint continuity of the derivative in the first variable
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space), ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) → Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (fun u : ℝ => F u p.2) p.1)

nodes.title: A derivative cone separates the endpoints of a curve segment
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (r : ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) (a b : ℝ) (v : LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space), a < b → ContinuousOn r (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ r t) → v ≠ 0 → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ‖deriv r t - v‖ < ‖v‖) → r a ≠ r b

nodes.title: Uniform separation away from coincident parameters modulo the period
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space), Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) → (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Function.Periodic (fun t : ℝ => F t s) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period) → (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Set.InjOn (fun t : ℝ => F t s) (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period)) → ∀ d : ℝ, 0 < d → d ≤ LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period / 2 → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period, d ≤ |x - y| → |x - y| ≤ LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period - d → ρ ≤ ‖F x s - F y s‖

nodes.title: Uniform lower bound and short-range variation of slice velocities
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space), ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) → (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period), deriv (fun u : ℝ => F u s) t ≠ 0) → ∃ m d : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ 0 < d ∧ d ≤ LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period / 4 ∧ (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period), m ≤ ‖deriv (fun u : ℝ => F u s) t‖) ∧ (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period), ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period), |x - y| < d → ‖deriv (fun u : ℝ => F u s) x - deriv (fun u : ℝ => F u s) y‖ < m / 4)
